scenes.text: Find the operation connecting consecutive terms. Use the same step to extend the sequence and justify it.
Continue: 9, 17, 25, ... What is term 5? The answer is 41. Term 5 is 9 plus 4 times 8 equals 41.
The values 22, 29, 36 describe a pattern at a market stall. What is the value at step 8 (counting the first as step 1)? Pause the video and think.
The values 22, 29, 36 describe a pattern at a market stall. What is the value at step 8 (counting the first as step 1)? The answer is 71. Term 8 is 22 plus 7 times 7 equals 71.
